paragraphs.source_en: The opposite choices, with the opposite effects, were being made in Persia. Persia became a center of philosophy and translation, including from Greek into Syriac and Syriac into Pahlavi (Middle Persian). This laid the groundwork for later Arabic thought, an even more significant chapter in the history of thought.86 Romanía had opted out of that trajectory.
